title: migrate: pre-fill RSA auth subkeys
description: parse_listing: RSA (algo 1) auth subkeys >=2048 bits and odd e are reusable; prefer ed25519/P-256 when a key has both. 89 live pgpkeys keys have only an RSA auth subkey, 12 have both.
acceptance_criteria: RSA-only auth subkey is pre-filled; ed25519 wins when both exist; RSA-1024 auth subkey is not pre-filled
